label: My return: the documents to keep handy
aliases: my return: the documents to keep handy

default.label: Your e-filing login (incometax.gov.in)
default.why: To download the pre-filled JSON, AIS and 26AS, and to file.

default.label: PAN, linked to Aadhaar - and the mobile number on Aadhaar
default.why: An unlinked PAN is inoperative; e-verifying needs the Aadhaar OTP.

default.label: Bank account for the refund - pre-validated on the e-filing portal
default.why: A refund is paid only to a pre-validated account (Profile > My Bank Account).

default.label: Pre-filled JSON for AY 2026-27
default.why: Your details, salary, TDS, taxes paid and bank accounts, from the department.

default.label: AIS (and TIS) for FY 2025-26
default.why: Interest, dividends, share and fund sales, and every TDS reported on your PAN.

default.label: Form 26AS
default.why: Your tax credit as the department holds it - the return is checked against it.

default.label: Form 16 from every employer in the year
default.why: Part A: TDS by quarter. Part B: salary, exempt allowances, deductions.

default.label: Salary slips (basic + DA) - if you claim HRA
default.why: HRA exemption is worked out on basic + DA.

default.label: Rent receipts and the landlord's PAN (rent above 1 lakh a year)
default.why: HRA (old regime) or 80GG when there is no HRA.

default.label: Home-loan interest certificate; rent and municipal tax of a house let out
default.why: Section 24(b) interest, and income from a house let out.

default.label: Interest certificates for savings and deposits (if AIS seems short)
default.why: Interest is taxable in full; 80TTA / 80TTB take a part off (old regime).

default.label: Capital-gains statement from your broker and CAMS / KFintech
default.why: Shares and funds sold in the year: 111A, 112A and other gains (ITR-2 above 1.25 lakh of 112A).

default.label: Proofs: 80C (PPF, ELSS, LIC, tuition), 80D health cover, NPS, donations with the donee's PAN
default.why: Old regime only, except the employer's NPS (80CCD(2)).

default.label: Advance-tax and self-assessment challans (BSR code, date, serial no.)
default.why: Tax you paid yourself counts only with its challan details.

default.label: Last year's return - and this year's, if you filed and want to compare
default.why: Losses carried forward, and a check of what was filed.

default.label: Foreign assets or income, if any (bank, shares, RSUs abroad)
default.why: Schedule FA - this makes it an ITR-2.

description_nl: 2026-10-06: what to have to hand before starting, grouped the way a person gathers them; a row whose kind is read ticks itself, the rest the person ticks. Words live here because the list IS the content (owner: 'clearly mention what documents one should keep handy').
